features: The smart film projector supports 180°free rotation, allowing easy projection on walls, ceilings or floors without complicated setup. It is suitable for various scenarios, including home theaters, leisure entertainment, children's education, video conferences or online teaching, meeting various use needs.

Support 1080P/4K resolution, the projector uses advanced LED technology to deliver bright and realistic projection effects. Perfect connectivity is achieved via WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0, compatible with 2.4G and 5G networks, ensuring smooth transmission. With a brightness of 200 ANSI lumens and a contrast ratio of 1500:1, it delivers stunning visual effects.

The efficient cooling system keeps the operating noise below 25 decibels, providing a quiet viewing environment. Equipped with HDMI, USB and audio interfaces, it can be easily connected to external devices such as laptops, TV drives and USB drives, allowing perfect compatibility and extending entertainment possibilities.
description: This smart projector is equipped with the latest Android TV 11.0 system, with a wide range of built-in applications. It provides easy access to mainstream streaming platforms such as Netflix, Prime Video, and YouTube, offering an extensive content library of over 500,000 movies
